comment: section: QA: result counts (78 facet searches from a QA list, re-recorded from the live API on 2026-10-24: the original qa.json counts were outdated)
Each case is an inquiry route; the count is the one the GUI reports in the page title ("[At least ]N result(s)", the API estimated_count). The checks are loose so that growing data keeps them green:
- nonzero cases expect at least the recorded count (ge);
- cases that hit the server's fuzzy fallback also expect its "similar data shown" notice;
- zero cases expect 0 plus their notice ("No hits" / "Unrecognized property"), so a page that failed to load cannot pass as 0.
The desc keeps the original qa.json value. Runs replay the recorded API responses; only --fresh-cache / --live re-check the counts against the API.
